userStories.title: Add WebSocket auth-token + Origin validation + loopback-default security baseline
userStories.description: As an operator, I need every WebSocket connection authenticated and origin-checked so the dashboard is not a remote-code-execution surface (grounded in CVE-2025-52882).
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway WS server binds to loopback (127.0.0.1) by default; network bind requires an explicit config flag
Every WS connection must present a valid auth token; connections without it are rejected (validated on connect, not only on Open event)
Server validates the Origin header against an allowlist; mismatches are rejected (CSWSH protection)
Rejected connections are logged with reason
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Done 2026-05-25. src/gateway/auth.ts: token (env|.data/auth-token|generated), Origin allowlist, timing-safe compare; verified on /ws/terminal upgrade in gateway. Verified matrix: no-token/bad-token/bad-origin all 401, valid token+origin connects. /api/config bootstraps the same-origin SPA token.
